messages:
vik: Heads-up — after the routing rollout this morning p99 for /v1/generate (widget-card) jumped ~260ms while p50/p95 stayed flat. looks scoped to a tiny sub-cohort in APAC. anyone digging?
nora: saw the spike in the heatmap. sample_count for that slice dropped from ~150 -> 7 at the same time. distribution looks bi-modal.
kevin: pulling traces now. early glance: a handful of requests hit an extra proxy in the fallback pool adding ~200-300ms transport. service_time unchanged.
vik: ok that's transport. console currently shows only endpoint-level percentiles which hides origin lineage. we should expose "lineage" (ingress/proxy/backend) in the latency card.
nora: +1. also we need a clear confidence indicator when sample_count is low. engineers keep treating p99 as gospel even when N<20.
kevin: telemetry quick fix: add query param origin=lineage to the /percentiles API so callers can request p99?origin=backend and compare. i'll open MET PR.
telemetry-bot: MET-204 created: add origin filter and sample_count in top-level percentile response.
vik: nice. ux quick wins: (1) tooltip shows sample_count and dominant origin; (2) badge amber if N<50 with hover text "percentiles may be unstable for small samples"; (3) add a toggle in the endpoint breakdown to filter out proxy origins.
ux-bot: UX task created: UX-88 - percentile confidence badge + origin toggle copy suggestions.
nora: short-term mitigation: can we mute high-sev p99 alerts for that slice if sample_count < 30? ops are getting paged for noisy blips.
kevin: agreed. i'll change alerting rule to treat low-sample p99 as info and include raw sample list in the alert body for triage.
vik: rollout UX note: when route weights change >2% for any cohort, show an inline note: "Routing change may affect tail latencies for small cohorts. View per-origin breakdown." This prevents surprise tickets.
nora: also handy: expose recent origin-weight trend in the rollout detail so PMs see if fallback/proxy weight crept up.
kevin: opened infra ticket INF-912 to audit why the routing tweak pushed some prefixes to fallback pool. link in the ticket contains repro script.
vik: repro snippet (lab):
```
for i in {1..300}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{time_total}\n" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?prefix=apac-small"; done | sort -n | tail -n 20
```
nora: good. once telemetry change lands i'll run backend-only percentiles to confirm root cause.
telemetry-bot: MET-204 updated with tests and a staging endpoint.
vik: thanks. action items recap: kevin telemetry PR, ux badge + toggle, kevin alert tweak, infra INF-912 audit. i'll watch staging and close loop in 24h. :thumbsup:
